def solve(t):
    n=len(t); m=len(t[0])

def transforms(g):
    n=len(g)
    r0=g
    r1=[row[::-1] for row in g]                     # h-flip
    r2=g[::-1]                                       # v-flip
    r3=[row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]]                # 180
    t=[[g[j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)] # transpose
    r4=[row[::-1] for row in t]; r5=t[::-1]
    r6=[row[::-1] for row in r5]; r7=r4[::-1]
    return [r0,r1,r2,r3,r4,r5,r6,r7]
def solve8(g,noise=2):
    n=len(g)
    Ts=transforms(g)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if g[i][j]==noise:
                vals=[T[i][j] for T in Ts if T[i][j]!=noise]
                if vals:
                    out[i][j]=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return out
